# Muse Hub

> Muse Hub is an open-source toolkit for Meta's Muse AI. Published by Atlas Agents Hub. The library includes 5,242 skills, 396 workflows, 15 specialist kits and 51 tool guides.

## Start here

- [Muse Hub](https://atlas-agents-hub.github.io/muse-hub/): choose a task, specialist or Space template.
- [Resource library](https://atlas-agents-hub.github.io/muse-hub/downloads.html): search skills, workflows and specialist kits.
- [Setup guides](https://atlas-agents-hub.github.io/muse-hub/public/index.html): browse setup and integration routes.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/Atlas-Agents-Hub/muse-hub/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): download and configure a kit in Muse.
- [Release packages](https://github.com/Atlas-Agents-Hub/muse-hub/releases/tag/v1.6.2): current downloadable assets.
- [Repository](https://github.com/Atlas-Agents-Hub/muse-hub): source code and documentation.
- [Sitemap](https://atlas-agents-hub.github.io/muse-hub/sitemap.xml): canonical website pages.
- [Expanded resource index](https://github.com/Atlas-Agents-Hub/muse-hub/blob/main/llms.txt): additional guides and resources.
